D‑Wave has been awarded a $1.5 million U.S. National Science Foundation grant to supply dual‑rail hardware for Yale University’s fault‑tolerant ERASE quantum‑computing project. The funding supports development of error‑correction schemes that enable scalable, reliable quantum processors. Coverage appears in multiple international news outlets aggregated by Google News.
